blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Jose Rizal University marched back into the NCAA men’s basketball Finals after defeating Letran in Game 2 of the Season 102 Final Four, 85-79, at Mall of Asia Arena on Thursday. The Heavy Bombers followed up their 102-98 overtime victory in Game 1 last Monday to complete the series sweep and return to the championship round, where they haven’t set foot in 18 years. “Credit goes to the players. They worked hard in practice even when nobody was watching. They were in the gym until the early hours of the morning. All the credit goes to them. They really wanted […]...
